systems.system: Civil registry unified system (2025 digitisation project)
systems.tiers: a national project of MAD 194 million launched in 2025 to digitise 38 million historical records across all 1,821 registry offices, with manual entry of paper records and offices connected to a unified system; the essay also says most of 1,282 principal rural registry offices (of about 2,200) had no connected computer systems as of 2018, citing the World Bank ID4D diagnostic
urban prefectures, regional and provincial police headquarters, national rollout planned
electronic health record in urban hospitals since 2009
